in_sanskrit.name: Azalika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Azalika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Azalika is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Radiant One'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing prosperity, wealth, and fortune, is often referred to as the 'Radiant One'.
